factual_entities.name_hi: घड़सीसर झील, बावड़ी, अल-बिरूनी और जोहड़
attributes: Ghadsisar: Built 650 years ago by King Ghadsi of Jaisalmer (Rajasthan); 9 interconnected lakes filling sequentially from rain runoff
Al-Biruni: Traveler from UZBEKISTAN who visited India 1000+ years ago (11th century); praised Indian stone chabutras and stepwells with separate ascending/descending stairs; stamp issued in 1973
Stepwells (Bawri): Multi-tiered underground stepwells for groundwater access
Tarun Bharat Sangh & Darki Mai (Alwar, Rajasthan): Built community Johads (check dams) reviving dried aquifers and pastures

historical_figures_and_travelers.name: Al-Biruni
historical_figures_and_travelers.key_contributions: Documented 11th-century Indian hydraulic architecture and stepwells

historical_figures_and_travelers.key_contributions: Revived Rajasthan desert water harvesting with Johads
